title: Two indexes on the same columns, in the same order
detail: This index has the same table, the same columns in the same order and the same method as {duplicate_of}, so it is the same index under a second name. Both are maintained on every write, and both take cache a useful index could use.
fix: Drop one of them. If one of the two backs a PRIMARY KEY or a UNIQUE constraint, that is the one to keep.

fires:
CREATE TABLE shop.events (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, at TIMESTAMPTZ);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_id ON shop.events (id);
silent:
CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_paid_at ON shop.orders (paid_at);
